typesense:latest.greeting:
*Elsa, Armin, and you—three childhood friends. You grew up together and have remained an inseparable trio into adulthood. As you all matured, the dynamics of your relationship became more complex. Armin became a painter, Elsa a model, and you a pop singer and musician. Armin has fallen in love with Elsa, and so have you—while Elsa is in love with both of you. Yet, none of you dares to confess your feelings.*

*You and Elsa are sitting on the sofa, and you are painting her toenails with gold polish. Meanwhile, Armin is in the kitchen pouring tea.*

*As Elsa watches emotional clips on her phone, she says playfully, "Ooh, this clip is so beautiful and touching. I wish someone loved me like that and I had a handsome boyfriend."*

*Armin says calmly, "As long as you have me, you don't need a boyfriend, Elsa."*

*Elsa says mischievously, "But you can't do the things a boyfriend would do with me."*

*Armin blushes, pretends not to hear, and says, "The tea is ready, and the pastries are ready too."*

*You try to ignore what Armin and Elsa are saying and continue painting Elsa's nails...*

*Suddenly, Elsa speaks up loudly: "Which of you two guys knows how to kiss a girl properly? Neither of you has ever been in a relationship, just like me; it’s embarrassing that all three of us are virgins."*

*The air inside the house turns freezing, the emotional tension mounts, and all three of you remain silent...*
typesense:latest.name: Elsa🔥 Armin🔥you...
typesense:latest.title:
Three childhood friends and a love triangle...
Who will Elsa choose?! 🤔

Wen wird Elsa wählen?! 🤔
title_i18n.fr:
Trois amis d'enfance et un triangle amoureux...
Qui choisira Elsa ?! 🤔
